explanation: In Spain, slurping noodles is considered impolite and disruptive in a restaurant setting, as Spanish dining culture values quiet, refined table manners. Unlike in some East Asian countries where slurping signals appreciation, in Spain it is seen as a lack of self-control or disrespect to fellow diners.
local_tip: Eat noodles silently by winding them around your fork and bringing them to your mouth without noise.

also_check.note: Slurping noodles is a compliment to the chef and enhances flavor.
Slurping is common and indicates enjoyment, especially in casual settings.
Slurping pasta is considered very bad manners and is avoided.
